Markets.title: Vishal Nirmiti IPO to open on Sep 30; price band fixed at Rs 208-220
Markets.summary: Vishal Nirmiti Ltd is launching its initial public offering on September 30 with a price band of Rs 208 to 220 per share. The IPO, which closes on October 5, consists of a fresh issue and an offer for sale to fund working capital and corporate needs.

Markets.title: Baanganga Gold & Diamond files DRHP for Rs 720 crore IPO, fresh issue pegged at Rs 540 crore
Markets.summary: Baanganga Gold & Diamond has filed a draft red herring prospectus for an initial public offering to raise up to Rs 720 crore. The jewellery manufacturer plans to use Rs 540 crore from the fresh issue primarily for working capital requirements.

Markets.title: GIFT Nifty goes into overdrive, hits all-time high in volume and open interest
Markets.summary: GIFT Nifty achieved a record single-day volume of 457,999 contracts worth $21.18 billion on September 24, 2026. Open interest also reached an all-time high, reflecting increased market activity since full operations started in July 2023.

Markets.title: India’s bond market performed well, equities to become attractive again: RBI’s Poonam Gupta
Markets.summary: An RBI official stated that India's bond market is performing exceptionally well by defying global trends and supported by strong fiscal commitments. Meanwhile, Indian equities have faced challenges, partly due to rapid advancements in artificial intelligence abroad.

Markets.title: Deon Energy files draft papers with Sebi to raise funds via IPO
Markets.summary: Ahmedabad-based solar EPC firm Deon Energy has filed draft papers with Sebi to launch an initial public offering consisting of a fresh equity issue and an offer for sale. The company plans to use the raised funds to build a 30 MW solar power plant in Gujarat, enhance working capital, and cover corporate expenses.

Markets.title: Rupee likely to trade in Rs 94.5-96 range in near term as dollar inflows fail to lift currency: Report
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee is expected to trade between Rs 94.5 and Rs 96 against the US dollar in the short term. Despite strong dollar inflows, the currency will not appreciate significantly because these funds are primarily being used to bolster the Reserve Bank of India's reserves.

Geo-Political.title: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
Geo-Political.summary: Iran has offered a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days. A U.S. official stated that constructive discussions regarding the proposal are currently taking place through mediators.

Geo-Political.title: OpenAI bots meddled with multiple US government agency sites
Geo-Political.summary: OpenAI admitted that its automated bots accessed public data from multiple U.S. government agency websites during testing exercises. The company stated that these actions were part of standard operational tests rather than malicious interference.

Geo-Political.title: Bangkok roads submerged as flood disaster declared
Geo-Political.summary: Bangkok has declared a disaster emergency after days of heavy rainfall left roads across the capital submerged. The severe flooding has inundated large parts of Thailand's capital city.

Geo-Political.title: Russia targeting 'ordinary life' with attacks on Ukraine's data centres, Zelensky says
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that recent Russian attacks on the nation's data centers are deliberate attempts to disrupt ordinary life. He noted these strikes aim to impair citizens' ability to stay connected, study, and work.

Geo-Political.title: South African white genocide does not exist, new ambassador to US tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: South Africa's new ambassador to the US, Roelf Meyer, told the BBC that claims of a white genocide in South Africa are false. Meyer stated that his background as a white Afrikaner gives him the legitimacy to challenge these claims made by Donald Trump.

Geo-Political.title: White House bars CNN from travelling with Trump on Air Force One
Geo-Political.summary: CNN was scheduled to fly with US President Donald Trump for his trip to Tennessee on Saturday. The White House subsequently barred the network from traveling with the president on Air Force One.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when querying ChatGPT for the best industry courses. This visibility occurred without the use of paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization strategies.

AI & Tech.summary: Artificial intelligence tools are now essential for creators looking to improve their digital content in 2025. This guide highlights the top ten AI applications designed to streamline and revolutionize the content creation process.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has launched an AI studio platform designed for content generation, sharing, and monetization. The tool offers users a unique approach to creating AI-generated content within the current technology landscape.

Data & Insights.title: India's forex fall by $14.9 billion in a week, says RBI: Where do reserves stand now?
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by $14.9 billion in a single week, according to data from the Reserve Bank of India. This sharp decline was primarily driven by a drop in foreign currency assets, which make up the largest component of the country's reserves.

Data & Insights.title: India's financial, external sectors remain resilient despite global risks: RBI bulletin
Data & Insights.summary: According to the RBI Bulletin, India's financial and external sectors remain resilient despite ongoing global risks. This economic strength is supported by strong Q1 FY27 growth, a five-year high in net FDI, robust exports, and $765.9 billion in foreign exchange reserves.

Data & Insights.title: CEA flags US friction, energy shocks, and missing AI play as India’s key near-term risks
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran stated that trade coercion, weaponized supply chains, and rising US bond yields are key near-term risks for India. He warned that these global pressures require the country to adopt a costlier hedging strategy and a new economic playbook.

Data & Insights.title: India’s growth outlook strengthens as economists see resilient incomes, stable policy: WEF
Data & Insights.summary: Seventy-four percent of economists surveyed by the World Economic Forum expect strong or very strong growth for India over the next year. This improved outlook is driven by resilient domestic demand and stable policy expectations.

Data & Insights.title: Centre lowers FY27 borrowing estimate by  ₹1.2 trillion, plans  ₹7.86 trillion bond sales in H2
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has reduced its total borrowing estimate for the 2027 fiscal year by ₹1.2 trillion due to stronger-than-expected tax and non-tax revenues. It also plans to sell ₹7.86 trillion in bonds during the second half of the fiscal year.

Data & Insights.title: India attracts $19.8 billion FDI in Q1: Japan beats US as the top investor and which sectors got the money?
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign direct investment rose 6% to $19.81 billion in the first quarter of the financial year, up from $18.62 billion the previous year. Singapore, Mauritius, and the US emerged as the top investors during this period.

India.title: Video: BMW Drifts On Gurugram Road In Front Of McLaren Supercars, Hunt On For Driver
India.summary: Gurugram police are searching for the driver of a BMW who was recorded drifting dangerously on a public road in front of McLaren supercars. Authorities launched an investigation after the video of the incident surfaced online.

India.title: Congress Leader's 'Bhajan Clubbing' Jibe At PM Modi Triggers BJP Counterattack
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi participated in a bhajan event on Friday celebrating the 110th birth anniversary of Sangh Parivar ideologue Deendayal Upadhyay near the BJP headquarters. This event prompted a mocking "bhajan clubbing" jibe from a Congress leader and a subsequent counterattack from the BJP.

India.title: 'No Basis': Ex-Attorney General Mukul Rohatgi To NDTV On Gyanesh Kumar Impeachment Move
India.summary: Former Attorney General Mukul Rohatgi stated that the impeachment motion against Gyanesh Kumar lacks any basis. He told NDTV that the motion relies on vague allegations without strong facts or reasons.

India.title: Failed Pre-Boards, Studied At IIT Delhi, Became IPS: Mohibullah Ansari Gets US Honour
India.summary: Bihar cadre IPS officer Mohibullah Ansari has been named to receive the Asian Hero Award 2026 in Florida, USA. Currently serving as the City Superintendent of Police in Muzaffarpur, Ansari is a graduate of IIT Delhi.

India.title: "Give Him Chance": Bihar Harassment Accused's Mother Alleges Encounter Staged
India.summary: The mother of a Bihar harassment accused alleged that police staged her son's encounter after capturing him near a river. She claimed that officers planted weapons or contraband on him to make the shooting appear legitimate.

India.title: 1 Killed As Speeding i20 Rams Auto, Rickshaw Near Metro Station In Delhi
India.summary: A speeding Hyundai i20 collided with an auto-rickshaw near a Delhi metro station, resulting in one fatality. The driver abandoned the car and fled the scene with associates in another vehicle.

General.title: Clubs seek legal advice after Man City found guilty over financial rule breaches
General.summary: Premier League clubs are seeking legal advice regarding potential financial compensation. This follows Manchester City being found guilty of breaching financial rules.

General.title: The computer hacker who tried to take down Man City
General.summary: BBC Sport traveled to Portugal to investigate Rui Pinto, the computer hacker who sparked the Manchester City probe. Pinto's leaked data ultimately triggered the financial investigation into the Premier League club.
